raw_comment: I notice that there is a lot more drought within the middle of the U.S. compared to the more coastal states. I also noticed that there is no considerable drought in Florida and parts of California, even though they are warmer states. I wonder what the agriculture is like in areas with severe drought, as they don’t have much (if any) rainfall to help their crops grow.  This relates to me and my community because there are more wildfires in places experiencing drought, and the wildfire smoke can be carried by wind and bring poor air quality to where I live. A catchy headline for this graph could be ' Droughts: How the US is Feeling the Heat '.
